label: Bible Study
prompt: Yet man is born unto trouble, as the _____ fly upward.
verse: Yet man is born unto trouble, as the sparks fly upward.
note: Eliphaz, the first of Job's friends to speak — true enough on trouble, wrong about why Job had it.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: One man of you shall chase a _____: for the LORD your God, he it is that fighteth for you, as he hath promised you.
verse: One man of you shall chase a thousand: for the LORD your God, he it is that fighteth for you, as he hath promised you.
note: Joshua's farewell math: one of you chases a thousand when the LORD is the one doing the fighting.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And before the throne there was a sea of glass like unto _____: and in the midst of the throne, and round about the throne, were four beasts full of eyes before and behind.
verse: And before the throne there was a sea of glass like unto crystal: and in the midst of the throne, and round about the throne, were four beasts full of eyes before and behind.
note: John's view of heaven's throne room includes a sea of glass, clear as crystal.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For we must all appear before the _____ seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.
verse: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.
note: Paul once stood before Gallio's judgment seat in Corinth itself (Acts 18) — his readers knew the picture.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall be _____.
verse: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped.
note: Blind eyes opened, deaf ears 'unstopped' — Jesus pointed John the Baptist's disciples to exactly these signs (Matthew 11:5).
